summary: Prudential plc filed a 6-K on August 27, 2026, announcing its half-year 2026 results. The results show new business profit up 8% to $1,384m, adjusted operating profit before tax up 9%, and a 15% increase in the interim dividend to 8.88 cents per share. The company announced an additional circa $0.3 billion share buyback, on top of previously announced programs totaling $2.5 billion for 2026 and 2027. These are routine earnings results and capital return updates, not a transformative special situation. There is no unusual event triggering a special-situation classification.
